current.text: He is projected to start for the Pelicans next to Zion Williamson, Dejounte Murray and likely Yves Missi.
Last season he took on a bigger usage load while Dejounte Murray, Herb Jones and others were out. Murray is back and will have the ball in his hands.
Experts expect his usage to drop with Murray back, and his minutes may come down from about 36 per game.
The Pelicans have a crowded rotation of about eight players who could start, but he is basically the team's only floor spacer.
The Pelicans reportedly want about three first-round picks and a young player for him. His team-friendly contract puts his trade value at its peak.
Experts say 9-cat rankings that put him around 12th or in the top 20 rate him too high. One calls his Yahoo rank of 35 too high, and another says he tends to go too early.

Experts disagree on a price in the 30s. Some call an ADP around 36 about right and see a pick in the 30s as good value in category leagues. Others say a Yahoo rank of 35 is too high. One expert ranks him 22nd in 8-cat roto.
His ESPN rank of 45 and ESPN ADP of 77 are too low.

durable.text: His projected category line has no weak category. FT%, 3PM, points and steals are his best categories.
Lloyd says he is worth more in category leagues than in points leagues.

note: He went for 20 USD in our league last season. Yahoo values him at 29 USD (average cost 18) and ESPN at 13 USD, which lines up with the expert view: a fair pick in the 30s to 40s, not a top-20 player. Because he has no weak category he fits any build, so 18 to 22 USD is a reasonable target, but I would not pay the Yahoo value of 29 USD. Early in the season, check his shot volume and minutes now that Dejounte Murray is back, and follow trade news before the 2027-03-04 deadline.
